reviews.title: Two months without service, ignored complaints, Ombudsman involvement, and a personal data breach
reviews.body:
I ported my number to Lebara in February and almost immediately lost access to all services -   I contacted Lebara repeatedly and each time, was given the same troubleshooting steps, none of which resolved the issue. 

After two months, I ported my number to another provider and submitted a formal complaint by email. It was ignored. I chased multiple times but received no response. I sent a recorded-delivery letter. That was also ignored. I emailed again asking for a response to my letter and, once again, received no reply.

I escalated the matter to the Ombudsman, who ruled in my favour and awarded compensation along with a written apology.  I was told Lebara had attempted to call me several times, despite the fact that the very basis of my complaint was that I could not receive calls. I then had to chase again for payment of the compensation. As expected, my emails were ignored.
I have now received only part of the compensation and am still waiting for the remainder, despite providing my bank details twice. 

To make matters even worse, the only apology letter I have received was addressed to somebody else -Lebara have disclosed another customer's personal information to me.

Can somebody from Lebara please explain when I will receive the outstanding compensation and the correct letter of apology?  The compensation is now long overdue and all of my emails are going unanswered.

My experience has been that Lebara only acted after Ombudsman involvement, and even then failed to fully comply with the outcome. This is undoubtedly the worst customer service I have ever experienced.
reviews.author: Adeline Derain

reviews.title: It has been over a month since I raised…
reviews.body: It has been over a month since I raised my complaint, and it remains completely unresolved with no follow-up from your team. My calls are constantly dropping, and I am still unable to receive short-code SMS messages. This level of service is unacceptable. If this is not resolved immediately, I will be escalating the matter to the regulatory authorities.
